اشترعن (form VIII)
# اِشْتَرَعْنَ (ištaraʕna) /iʃ.ta.raʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اُشْتُرِعْنَ (ušturiʕna) /uʃ.tu.riʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# اِشْتَرِعْنَ (ištariʕna) /iʃ.ta.riʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
